project: Science Legends — 20-round visual and combat review
method: Twenty sequential evaluator-to-implementer rounds. A round is verified only after its change and acceptance evidence are reviewed.

sources.lesson: Keep dangerous enemy actions readable; match effect timing and impact direction to the underlying attack. Reserve the largest effects for stronger abilities.
Preserve coherent hero and monster identities while improving spell silhouettes, status colors and icon contrast.
A richer presentation should remain accessible through clear controls and modern usability improvements.
Enemy archetypes and elite identities can communicate different combat problems through distinct silhouettes, names and behavior.
Freeze, stun, slow and damage-over-time effects have different mechanical meanings and need distinguishable presentation.
Combat clarity benefits from many small, deliberate improvements in animation, feedback and presentation.
Keep codex and upgrade-screen feedback clear, and avoid interrupting combat with secondary information.

art_policy: Original generated artwork and original implementation; no extracted commercial-game assets.

verified_rounds.idea: Lock the view and align pointing with rendering
verified_rounds.finding: The renderer added random camera offsets after saving an unshaken input camera; oversized viewports also had invalid clamp bounds.
verified_rounds.change: A pure fixed orthographic view and shared inverse coordinate functions now drive rendering and mouse aim. Oversized viewports center the arena.
verification: Evaluator reviewed camera/input integration.
Evaluator independently ran all3 view mapping/bounds/determinism tests: passed.
Independent QA passed32 real-page camera/input checks with DPR1/2, CSS scaling, resize and oversized viewports.

verified_rounds.idea: Keep hero models upright and grounded through every skill
verified_rounds.finding: Whirlwind rotated the entire hero image and duplicated spin/nonspin rendering, visually changing its elevation and orientation.
verified_rounds.change: One actor contract keeps fixed52px hero size and a foot anchor; only horizontal facing changes, while weapon/ring effects still spin.
verification: Evaluator independently ran all5classes×4facings×spin/idle anchor/size regression: passed.
Reviewed whole-hero rotation removal and preserved override path.

verified_rounds.idea: Bring every hero class to life with coherent generated model poses
verified_rounds.finding: The game used two-frame pixel sprites and one static override, without a coherent high-fidelity action animation set.
verified_rounds.change: All5 heroes now use premeasured generated idle, alternating stride and attack cells at a constant72px size; previews refresh after atlas load and custom overrides keep priority.
verification: Evaluator reviewed one-time alpha baseline measurement and fixed source-cell sizing.
Evaluator independently ran3 model/animation/foot-anchor tests: passed.
Implementer passed35 real premium-page browser checks and inspected a generated Sorcerer attack pose.
Evaluator independently passed92 real-page generated-model matrix/crop/pose checks and inspected renderer screenshot.
Independent art QA547dad4 passed17 real-page assertions including distinct generated frames, source proportions, pause and render purity.

verified_rounds.idea: Give every enemy archetype a coherent animated model
verified_rounds.finding: Enemy identities were simple two-frame pixel forms without action or crowd-control animation states.
verified_rounds.change: All6 archetypes now use generated fixed-view atlas models with measured ground anchors, real movement and attack poses, frozen/stunned holds, charge bracing and safe override fallback.
verification: Evaluator reviewed enemy action integration and atlas cache.
Evaluator independently ran all4 model tests, including unique columns and control-effect frames: passed.
Implementer ran240 skill/ultimate stress combinations successfully.
Evaluator inspected all6 generated enemy silhouettes in a real renderer screenshot.
Independent art QA547dad4 passed17 real-page assertions including distinct generated frames, source proportions, pause and render purity.

verified_rounds.finding: The old renderer drew every foe and companion behind the hero regardless of ground position, contradicting the apparent fixed view.
verified_rounds.change: Hero, enemies and companions share a stable foot-y queue; ground contacts/shadows render beneath bodies and actor health labels render above them.
verification: Evaluator independently ran5 model/depth tests and92 real-page model matrix checks: passed.
Implementer passed38 premium browser checks including actual back-to-front ordering at1280/390/320px.

verified_rounds.idea: Animate real attack events without letting rendering deal damage
verified_rounds.finding: Melee, elemental contact and cast effects lacked a shared multi-frame visual sequence lifecycle.
verified_rounds.change: A bounded simulation-timed atlas adapter now animates4-frame melee, fire, frost and arcane events at actual cast/contact locations. Drawing has no damage callbacks and effects expire.
verification: Evaluator independently ran19 action/model/combat tests: allpassed.
Reviewed real slash/explosion/nova/cast/impact emission and bounded visual-only queue.
Implementer passed240 skill/ultimate stress combinations.
Independent art QA547dad4 passed17 real-page assertions including distinct generated frames, source proportions, pause and render purity.

verified_rounds.idea: Give elemental attacks their own readable identities
verified_rounds.finding: Poison, holy, lightning and arrows shared generic fire or purple contact effects, and a nonsquare atlas risked vertical stretching.
verified_rounds.change: Actual elemental events carry explicit families and play the cleaned4-frame elemental sheet. Source frame aspect ratios are preserved and existing lightning path cues remain.
verification: Evaluator independently ran16 action/contact/combat tests: allpassed.
Reviewed actual poison explosion, holy contact, lightning and Amazon release integration.
QA identified4:3 frame proportions; implementation preserves source aspect.
Independent art QA547dad4 passed17 real-page assertions including distinct generated frames, source proportions, pause and render purity.

verified_rounds.idea: Make crowd-control and damage-over-time states visible and accurate
verified_rounds.finding: Effects were hard to distinguish from body color, and an expired high damage-over-time magnitude could survive a weaker later application.
verified_rounds.change: Deterministic shape/text badges distinguish FROZEN, STUN, SLOW, BLEED and VENOM at model-head height. Expired DoT strength/type clears; later applications use the correct winning source and remaining duration.
verification: Evaluator independently ran10 model/action/status tests: allpassed.
Reviewed poison source metadata and remaining-duration integration.
Fire DoT was additionally tagged BURN with its own shape/text badge.

verified_rounds.idea: Make ranged enemy attacks commit before release
verified_rounds.finding: Spitter projectiles appeared instantly when cooldown expired, offering no readable preparation or dodge decision.
verified_rounds.change: A locked-direction0.4s cast braces the Spitter, shows a dashed path/progress ring/SPIT label above player effects, emits exactly one shot, and follows with recovery. Control effects pause safely and death cancels release.
verification: Evaluator independently ran10 AI/model tests: allpassed.
Production updateEnemies regression proves bracing, no early shot, no launch retarget, freeze safety and one release.

verified_rounds.idea: Give heavy melee attacks anticipation, commitment and recovery
verified_rounds.finding: Brutes and bosses applied contact damage instantly, with no meaningful heavy-attack preparation or dodge window.
verified_rounds.change: Heavy foes lock a target footprint, brace for0.45s, resolve one contact only if that target remains inside, and recover for0.65s. SMASH/progress and RECOVER cues remain above player effects; smaller foe behavior stays intact.
verification: Evaluator independently ran5 AI tests: allpassed.
Production updateEnemies regression proves no early damage, exactly one contact and enforced recovery.
Reviewed control/death cancellation and safe committed pet targeting.

verified_rounds.idea: Make the companion roster visually coherent with the new heroes
verified_rounds.finding: Animals and humanoid followers still used old pixel forms beside the newly generated actors.
verified_rounds.change: Four beast companions use generated action cells; Defender, Mage, healer, Valkyrie and decoy reuse matching hero models with explicit friendly role badges and ground contacts. Actual movement, attacks and healing drive animation; override aliases remain.
verification: Evaluator independently ran8 model/status/companion mapping tests: allpassed.
Reviewed real pet movement/attack/heal pose tracking and preserved gameplay rules.
Cross-cell source fragments are tracked as an open asset-quality follow-up for round19.
Independent actual-renderer QAea86591 passed20 art checks including all16 beast cells,5 humanoid roles and real boar override priority.

verified_rounds.idea: Build a readable illustrated skill sanctum
verified_rounds.finding: The large skill graph retained a flat white surface and lacked a clear visual state legend.
verified_rounds.change: Generated tree art and interface ornaments now frame a scoped dark skill surface with brighter functional edges, readable states/popovers/stats, a shape/text legend and viewport-aware popovers.
verification: Evaluator independently ran47 real premium browser checks: allpassed.
Evaluator visually inspected390px tree screenshot: actual decorative art, clear activegraph and bounded popover.
Implementer passed24 accessibility and88 existing gameplay browser checks.

verified_rounds.idea: Make a large skill graph navigable without hundreds of Tab presses
verified_rounds.finding: Node buttons lacked descriptive names and stable spatial keyboard browsing; rerendering could lose focus.
verified_rounds.change: One logical Tab entry supports arrows/Home/End, named ranks/requirements, inspect-only Enter/Space, visible focus scrolling, retained allocation focus, popover-first Escape and clean T close. Learn feedback is announced.
verification: Evaluator independently ran24 real-page keyboard/allocation/focus checks at1280/390px: allpassed.
Independent full-page UI18checks also passed.
Reviewed navigation as inspection only, preserving explicit point allocation.

verified_rounds.idea: Find skills and understand prerequisite routes
verified_rounds.finding: Locating advanced abilities in a176-node graph required manually scanning and panning without branch context.
verified_rounds.change: Literal local search provides live counts/results and next-match navigation. Activation focuses the real node and highlights its prerequisite ancestry/edges while preserving rank and point rules; clear/no-result states are explicit.
verification: Evaluator independently ran38 real browser search/navigation/locked-node checks: allpassed.
Evaluator independently ran2 spatial/literal-search/ancestry unit tests: allpassed.
Reviewed literal matching and unchanged canLearn/allocation semantics.

verified_rounds.idea: Let players target the visible model rather than a hidden small circle
verified_rounds.finding: Clicking the visible head of a large brute missed its collision-circle picker and issued a movement command.
verified_rounds.change: Hover and click now share cached rendered-body bounds and frontmost-foot-depth picking. A generated-frame target readout shows enemy identity, elite/boss rank, numeric health and statuses, clearing stale targets without altering combat radii.
verification: Evaluator independently ran30 real targetbrowser checks at1280/390/320: allpassed.
Evaluator independently ran9 model/status/body-picking tests: allpassed.
Visible headclick, overlap order, groundwalk, all6 archetypes and boss/death readouts covered.

asset_quality_followups.finding: Some globally separate sprites cross nominal atlas cell boundaries, creating clipped anatomy and foreign fragments under fixed grid cropping.
asset_quality_followups.evidence: Independent QA found exact expected component counts; extraction benchmark12–22ms/atlas. Fullsprite bounds rarely overlap; one frontbrute pair overlaps2px and needs masking.
